snippet.title: A Dogs Dream | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
What kind of dreams have you had?

After enduring recurring nightmares,
the developer decided to create this game.
Choices are given endlessly,
but none of them are safe.

Abandon conscience. Abandon knowledge.
Trust only your senses to escape this nightmare.

Add it to your Steam wishlist now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4159350/a_Dogs_Dream/
